wearFallback.note: all-race median used when a race fit is unreliable

meta.neutralMethod: field median > 1.08 x p15 of race field medians; lap 1 excluded
meta.pitLossMethod: in-lap + out-lap - 2 x median of 3 clean laps before; green stops only; 5-45 s
meta.wearMethod: OLS lap time ~ stint age + race lap, driver fixed effects (demeaned)
